evidence_excerpts.normalized_excerpt: Stafl jumps up from behind the wall and takes aim with his crossbow, landing a perfect shot and killing the second monster. The third monster releases Thrin and charges at Bonogo. Ogonob gets a decent hit in before the creature attacks Bonogo with a claw attack and bite, dealing big damage and leaving behind festering wounds. It then attempts to grapple Bonogo, but he dodges out of reach. Karsemine watches and Thrin once again is being pulled into the ground and then suddenly hears screaming coming from the west along the wall. Baergom boosts temporary HP for Stafl, Ephanna, Caelynn and Lysandra.

Lysandra uses her Commanding Shout and directs Karsmine, Stafl and Caelynn to attack or move. Karsemine uses her bow, and Caylynn her crossbow, to deal more damage to the remaining monster. Then Lysandra casts Leadership and gives Karsemine a boost to her next attack, which she uses to cast Fire Bolt on the monster, killing it by fully engulfing it in flames. Now she has a chance to head down the length of the wall to where she heard the screaming before. As she starts she can feel the ground begin to shake and sees town guards gesturing over the wall where she can just make out dark shapes moving below. Just before Bonogo is able to turn to help Thrin get up, Thrin is again pulled into the ground and fully disappears out of sight.

However, as soon as they cast Firebolt and Bonfire the remaining piles turn to goo and are sucked into the ground. With the battle over and full night upon them, the group must decide what to do next. Something needs to be done with the refugees from Edge, while some members need a much needed rest to regain spells. The group decides to split up along those lines: Ephanna, Stafl and Baergorm will stand watch at the wall above the gate, taking a short rest and recovering. The others will go check on the town and create a plan for the refugees.

evidence_excerpts.normalized_excerpt: Meanwhile, Caelynn and Baergrom enter the herbal shop and are met with the overwhelming scent of herbs. Elara Greenleaf, an Elf Druid, greets the new visitors. The first question she asks is if Caelynn is elvish. She then yells to the back and Talia, a half-elf, comes out to help as well. Despite a shop full of herbs, Caelynn is most interested in finding out information about the glowing mushrooms. She offers 1 pound in exchange for information and 2 gold for a copy of the information from the book. (A very cool mushroom card is given with details hidden under a scratch off area). They soon discover that the mushrooms are very rare and extremely dangerous. Caelynn will need to take the mushrooms to the Head Alchemist at Stormspire Academy to see about making them into a potion.

Without so much as considering buying any of Torvak’s incredible Hemp, the team marched on eager to investigate this bizarre tree.
